import os
import pytest
from src.loader import load


def test_plain(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / 'c.txt'
    p.write_text('hi')
    assert load(str(p)) == 'hi'


def test_symlink_refused(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / 'c.txt'
    p.write_text('hi')
    link = tmp_path / 'l.txt'
    os.symlink(p, link)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        load(str(link))
